Description:
std::uint32_t optinal member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined base_frequency
29 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype CRF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00 00 00 00 ... 0x1F FF FF FF : valid
0x20 00 00 00 ... 0xFF FF FF FF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set the value of base_frequency to the configured value,
if it is not be provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
